verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents graph composition (nodes and edges), interrupts and resume, checkpointing, and output streaming. None of it shows rules that automatically trigger actions when external events occur. Graph edges and deterministic steps are developer building blocks for control flow, and streaming exposes execution output rather than event-driven triggers, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
